PRIVATE, DRY-RUN ONLY - u2algo / efloud-bot connector readiness re-check. NO publishing, NO post creation, NO message sending, NO external actions on any platform. Only inspect, read, and report.

1) Instagram connector (UUID 4b899211-fd12-410e-a8d2-264a409cbc78) su anda hangi Instagram Business/Professional hesabina bagli? Gecen sefer @leblepito gorunmustu; hedefimiz @u2algo. get_account_info veya esdegeri read-only cagri ile bagli hesabin @handle'ini, hesap adini, hesap turunu (Business/Creator) ve bagli reklam hesabi varsa act_ ID'sini raporla.

6) Diger connector'lar: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Canva, HeyGen, Kling, Flux, ElevenLabs, Playwright, My Browser, Apify, Firecrawl, PostHog, Sentry, Ahrefs, Similarweb, Mailchimp, HubSpot, Intercom, Supabase, Vercel, Cloudflare, Notion, Airtable, Linear, GitHub, Gmail, Google Calendar icin config durumunu ve authorize edilmis olup olmadiklarini tek tablo halinde ozetle.
